items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: They thought the world of Mr. Lewis.

ctx.x: He had been with Claude Hopkins.

Claude Hopkins. He'd been with a lot of different bands around. And he was the manager of the show, and he turned out to be a very good manager, too. I mean, I was actually surprised. Well, he had did it before. He managed a big show, a big USO show over in Europe. That was before he come with us. And he was very successful with it. They thought the world of Mr. Lewis.
So anyway, all together, intact, we had thirteen people, including the three women.
